title: Calculate Beachhead Market TAM
not_for: A revenue forecast, valuation, or summing overlapping markets.
input_gate: Specify economic units, annual revenue per unit, exclusions, and source assumptions. Missing inputs belong in a research plan, not made-up totals.

example_note: For the base case, 200 practices times EUR 960 per year gives EUR 192,000 annual TAM. This is 100% market potential, not forecast sales.
failure_case: Mixing monthly prices with annual revenue, missing scenarios, or a total that differs from units times annual revenue is rejected.
